title.zh: DSH 插件索引 · 观察池

description.en: Passed every hard gate but scored low or carries unresolved soft warnings.
description.zh: 通过全部硬门，但分数偏低或带有未解决的软风险。

description.en: Catppuccin themes + a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the official theme system (Appearance settings), fully remapping the --dsw-* token ladder, with adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer and t…

Scene-aware storyboard for DeepSeek Harness: one addressable grid per video (numbered cells, timestamps, transcript, audio envelope) so a text-only agent can look at the video itself instead of being told a summary.
Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付
Automatic provider/model fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness agents when LLM requests keep failing (retry exhausted, auth, quota, rate limit)
DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct
只填 Key 的服务商预设：57 家渠道为 DSH 一键写入官方 llm-pi-ai 路由与凭据（插件），并可写入腾讯 WorkBuddy、OpenCode（Key 走其 auth.json）与 cc-switch 的配置（CLI）；核心为纯 JS，可被更多应用的外壳复用。
Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作 + 原生视觉模型接入（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 直读截图），screen_observe 等 20 个模型友好工具；浏览器组 browser_* 为兜底
在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。

SparkElf-maintained fork of dsh-quant: AI-native & DSH-native quant toolkit — 59 tools across 6 pluggable domains (data/alpha/ML/risk/execution), one end-to-end PDAT→PET research pipeline. Fork adds A-share-correct annualization, cross-sectional IC, and unit-consistent win rates. Methods open, secr…

DSH plugin: one shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2, or WSL on Windows, plus an embedded terminal for the bottom dock (dsh-better-sidebar's terminal tab) with per-shell activation switches and a default-shell fallback chain.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render the session brief — the todo list (the `todos` projection board) plus the artifact list (a live produced-files feed, codeplan artifacts marked) — as a summary tab in the right sidebar, and shadow the official composer-band todo panel so the board…

Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), with all-or-nothing application, read-before-write intent dance, sandbox-aware delete/move,  (declarative volatile settings).

Cut token cost without cutting model intelligence — a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle plugin: structure-aware compression + TOON-style lossless encoding first + reversible spill-to-disk + real-time dashboard.
yhbd.top 插件雷达：DSH 侧边栏 plugin_top 按钮 + 大面板（顶层「全部」+ 站点同款细分榜单：原生星榜·飙升·今日新秀·兼容工具·分类冠军；分类条随榜单联动；「安装」写入「先了解+安全审查」引导语），数据由插件内嵌的同源 HTTP 反代拉取，无需 CORS / nginx 配置；附带 Agent 可调用的搜索/榜单工具。
高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停 + 官方源二维判定 + 会话级冻结 + 后端自动重试。
DSH Web 插件：会话管家（合并包）—— 会话历史文件（归档浏览与清理）与健康检查（体检 → 处方 → 出院），外加独立 FTS5 会话内容搜索索引（标题/内容双模式、增量同步、非破坏性整理与快照导入导出）。不碰会话日志、只做可逆处置。
One plugin for a calmer DeepSeek Harness: reading view + message rail + smart history loading, for Harness 0.1.0-0.2.1 (all rc).
Bring text-to-video and image-to-video generation to DeepSeek Harness — DashScope Wanx, Volcengine/Doubao Seedance, Google Veo, OpenAI Sora & compatible relays.
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.
DataOps JWT intake and credential-backed MCP tools for managed DeepSeek Harness workspaces.
DataOps Task Center and Task Bus for the official DSH Web shell.

Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: let the model schedule its own alarms (once / interval / cron with random jitter), wake cold sessions on time, gate model-initiated follow-ups with quiet hours and a daily budget, and reclaim silent wake turns with tombstone compaction; ships a we…

Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus three mid-stream breakers that end …
DSH plugin: assistants, virtual users and pair memory bound to sessions (host part)
DSH Market 插件端：cordis 侧边栏插件（浏览/搜索/猜你喜欢/一键安装/已装管理），核心逻辑来自 @dsh-market/core
DSH Archive Manager - preview, restore, and delete archived sessions from the settings page
Claude Style — Anthropic warm-editorial skin for the dsh web GUI, distilled from anthropic.com
iPolloWork HyperFrames Video Studio and 27 editable video templates as a native DeepSeek Harness conversation view.
AgentOne 平台集成：平台模型、SkillHub 技能与技能包（包目录一键安装/可选/自动装齐）、套餐、CLI、飞书云盘共享文件夹（web/官方桌面端侧栏页签 + 左栏底部入口）、左栏「工作台」面板；插件装前宿主兼容预检；官方桌面端「关于」页自升级修复：分离进程 pnpm 通道绕开宿主 already-installed 死路（Windows 适配），附「让 AI 代升级」一句话引导
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
Switch the DSH web interface to Anthropic Sans Web Text and model conversation to Anthropic Serif Web Text.
DeepSeek Harness 心情图标插件：把 web 端 logo/状态点换成 bloub 心情形象（8 形状 × 12 色 × 16 表情，随会话状态自动切换），内置桌面启动子功能（macOS/Windows 桌面入口共用 dsh web 后端），设置页中英双语。
Vision bundle + plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the describe_image tool reads local images and asks any configured multimodal route, with zero core changes
DSH Desktop 界面增强：页内查找（Cmd+F）、轮次编号、上下文压缩行常显、建议、每步耗时、折叠文件夹状态计数、会话信息（含上下文注入 C1 视图）、工具管理、Skill 管理、独立远程接入与手机体验。
Prompt injection, subagent routing, Skill install, rtk output compaction, MCP servers and image generation for DSH — one switchable plugin row each, configured from a settings page in the Web UI
DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。
DSH plugin: read and send Outlook email, search the mailbox and manage the calendar through Microsoft Graph (application permissions)
A lightweight, selectable smart-routing mode for DeepSeek Harness.
GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness: native web_search via the Anthropic-compatible Messages API, with GLM response-format translation.
DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.

dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a DeepSeek Harness web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed loop on RDB persistence, with the conversatio…
RDB durable session backend for DeepSeek Harness: implements both session-persistence and session-branch (rewind / retry / fork) providers.
Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.
